title: Story
text: How do Americans view their leaders, and how does public sentiment toward the White House compare to attitudes toward Congress and political parties? By analyzing monthly Gallup polling data from 1993 to 2025, we can track how public approval, congressional approval, and party favorability interact across five presidential administrations.

title: Story
text:
About
This project was developed for Milestone 4 in Preceptor’s Primer for Bayesian Data Science. It examines historical trends in American political sentiment using monthly polling series from Gallup.

Data Sources:

Presidential job approval ratings (1945–2025) via Gallup and the American Presidency Project.
Congressional job approval ratings (1974–2025) via Gallup Historical Trends.
Party favorability ratings (1992–2024) via Gallup.

Interactive Exploration: To view individual administration trends with month-by-month animations from Harry Truman to Joe Biden, visit the Exploration page.
